map.EV 值代表什么含义？: What does the EV value represent?
map.EV（曝光值）量化进光量，数值每加 1 表示进光量翻倍、减 1 表示减半；它是光: EV (Exposure Value) quantifies the light intake; each increase of 1 means double the light, and each decrease of 1 means half; it is the combined result of aperture, shutter, and ISO.

map.EV=log₂(N²/t) 只由光圈与快门定义，EV 加 1 表示这组光圈/快门: EV = log₂(N²/t) is defined only by aperture and shutter; +1 EV means one stop less light in that aperture/shutter combination (half the optical exposure). ISO only changes brightness gain, not the optical light entering the lens.
